description: Unified filter and paging options for querying TmWorkItems.

members.name: Ids
members.description: Specific work item ids to resolve.

members.name: OriginPageId
members.description: Optional source page id filter (e.g. Notion page).

members.name: ParentId
members.description: Optional parent id filter (children of a given item).

members.name: QueryString
members.description: Opaque provider-native query string (e.g. Jira JQL).

members.name: RangeEnd
members.description: Items overlapping this range (scheduling queries). Inclusive upper bound.

members.name: RangeStart
members.description: Items overlapping this range (scheduling queries). Inclusive lower bound.

members.name: Skip
members.description: Number of matching items to skip.

members.name: SourceKey
members.description: Optional source/provider key filter (registry lookup). Null queries the resolved provider as-is.

members.name: Take
members.description: Maximum number of items to return.
